newsitem.title: USA: Johnson Controls to supply AutoZone.
newsitem.headline: Johnson Controls to supply AutoZone.

text.p: Johnson Controls Inc said Tuesday retailer AutoZone Inc has extended a supply contract to buy automotive, lawn and garden, marine and heavy duty commercial batteries.
Terms of the contract were not disclosed.
Johnson Controls had been the sole supplier of AutoZone owned and licensed battery brands for the last three years, and the new agreement extends the contract for five years, Johnson Controls said.
AutoZone has more than 1,500 retail outlets in North America and sells automotive batteries under the brand names Duralast and Duralast Gold.
